plugins.name: gilbreth
plugins.description: A guided work-breakdown workflow for Tusk-backed projects: recursively decomposes a fuzzy idea down a fixed taxonomy (Project → Milestone → Initiative → Story → Task) into atomic, agent-ready tasks, with brainstorm → spec → plan → phase-review gates at every level

plugins.name: elephant
plugins.description: Makes Tusk the agent's short-to-medium-term memory keeper: capture learnings broadly into a knowledge graph and recall them narrowly across sessions.
